name: Robust Z-Score Normalization using Median and Interquartile Range (IQR)
description: Standardizing skewed metrics (like API response latency) for machine learning feature pipelines requires scaling by IQR (Q3 - Q1) rather than standard deviation.
prompt:
Standardizing skewed metrics (like API response latency) for machine learning feature pipelines requires scaling by IQR (Q3 - Q1) rather than standard deviation.

Execute the required analytical SQL calculation in DuckDB.
Expected output columns: request_id, latency_ms, robust_iqr_z_score.
Results should be ordered as specified.
golden_sql:
-- Compute robust IQR-normalized score: (x - Q2) / (Q3 - Q1)
            WITH quartiles AS (
                SELECT 
                    QUANTILE_CONT(latency_ms, 0.25) AS q1,
                    QUANTILE_CONT(latency_ms, 0.50) AS median_val,
                    QUANTILE_CONT(latency_ms, 0.75) AS q3
                FROM response_times
            )
            SELECT 
                r.request_id,
                r.latency_ms,
                ROUND((r.latency_ms - q.median_val) / NULLIF(q.q3 - q.q1, 0), 3) AS robust_iqr_z_score
            FROM response_times r
            CROSS JOIN quartiles q
            ORDER BY robust_iqr_z_score DESC;
why_it_fails: Standard Z-score produces biased features when distributions have heavy tails.
